title: WALK IN INTERVIEW FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY (LAW) & GUEST FACULTY (ENGLISH)
text:
KEY LINES:
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.

FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF LAWS
PANJAB UNIVERSITY REGIONAL CENTRE, LUDHIANA
WALK IN INTERVIEW
FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY (LAW) & GUEST FACULTY (ENGLISH)
Venue : Panjab University Regional Centre, Ludhiana.
Posts No. of seats Honorarium
Guest Faculty (Laws) 01 Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to maximum of
Rs. 50,000/- per month
Guest Faculty (English) 01 Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to maximum of
Rs. 50,000/- per month
Walk in Interview for appointment of Guest Faculty (English) to teach B.A.LL.B (Hons.) and
Guest Faculty (Law) to teach BA.LL.B (Hons), LL.B and LL.M will be held at UIL, PU. Regional
Centre Ludhiana (date of walk in interview shall be displayed later on at www.purcl.puchd.ac.in )
Minimum Qualification is as per UGC/P.U. norms.
Days of teaching Classes to be taught Subject to be taught Working hours
Monday to Friday As per requirement As per requirement 9.00 a.m.
to
4.00 p.m.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents including
publications (with photocopy of certificates) for verification along with the duly filled form giving the details at
the time of interview.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-
forms.php pages 1 to 9.
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any
financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching in the University Institute of Laws, P. U. Regional
Centre, Ludhiana as a Guest Faculty.
-sd-
Director
